The x-axis is not on a linear scale; it displays four distinct categories: '0', '1,2', '3,7', and '7.max'.
The x-axis does not have a uniform numerical tick interval of 1.2; it uses categorical labels.
The y-axis range shown in the figure is from 0.4 to 1, not 0.6 to 0.9.
